verdict.rationale: cubic supports a repo-root `cubic.yaml` that serves as the source of truth for AI review behavior and custom agents. Custom agents are review rules that enforce a team's coding standards and best practices, and an org-wide `cubic-config` repo can supply defaults for repos without their own file. Missing for 10: detail on how conventions and instructions are written in the file (syntax or examples), evidence that these standards also guide cubic's fix/code-generation agent rather than only review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
